snippet.title: Project Kouvola - MINI TRAILER... 4?: "Confidential" | [ENG]
snippet.description:
That's right!
After a long time, and only a couple of months before the launch.

Project Kouvola is finally arriving on Steam despite many issues that have been accumulating over time.
The release date for winter 2025 still remains in place, and I hope to the fullest that there are no delays. I've been working really hard behind the scenes.

Meanwhile... You can add the game to your Steam wishlist to buy it as soon as it becomes available.

Note: (As mentioned in Trailer 3, the Steam version will have a price, although it will include for free the second part “Harmony in Disaster” when it comes out, soon.
You will still be able to get the part 1 for free on itch.io as planned... But only that, sorry... I really appreciate the support though :'3 
All of this is very expensive to do!!!!)

itch.io: https://lowmoondev.itch.io/project-kouvola
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3908770/Project_Kouvola/
Twitter: https://x.com/LowMoonDev
